subject: reasoning
question: Six friends J, K, L, T, U, and V are sitting around a round table, facing the center. V sits second to the right of L, who is second to the right of U. J sits immediate right of U. T sits second to the left of K. How many people sit between T and U, counting from the left of T?
solution:
Six friends J, K, L, T, U, and V are sitting around a round table, facing the center.

 
• V sits second to the right of L, who is second to the right of U.
 
• J sits immediate right of U.
 
• T sits second to the left of K

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c91ddfb01ef90d42ff8a8db94a26fb63f87c0c00fef9e0dfd9412856bc74546.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
